scope: Read-only current native source, upvalue type/boolean and modal-visibility inspection. No gameplay RPC/reset, callback invocation, hook or private-flag change. No account/client IDs or private values retained.

sourceFacts.prestigeBusy: PrestigeModal.init upvalue5 is the private busy boolean; set true synchronously before task.spawn and reset false after PrestigeAction returns. Reading it is not exclusive ownership.
sourceFacts.context: PrestigeModal.init/open share current native context and Root.Modals/PrestigeModal instances.
sourceFacts.sharedConfirmation: MWClient assigns ctx.confirmDialog=FightTab.confirm. Its closure holds Root.Modals at1, pending callback at3 (nil at observation), native context at4. No pending callback value was copied.
sourceFacts.confirmationLifecycle: openConfirm assigns callback and shows native ConfirmModal. ConfirmButton copies callback, clears stored callback, closes modal and invokes copy synchronously; Cancel/hide clear the callback. closeModal only changes native visibility; hub must never call or answer these for a probe.

limitations: Observed native idle/modal/callback checks are not an atomic native/hub lease; simultaneous manual UI interleaving remains an external ownership gap.
No live reset was sent or authorized. The exact positive reset reply variant and current-client integrated lifecycle remain unverified; missing/nonexact replies and effects remain held.
Current executable entry does not permit Prestige; source is uncommitted/unpinned. No native private flag/callback was changed or invoked.
Historical checkpoints without owned Prestige ordinals remain unknown; no automatic consumed-attempt migration/reset.
